summary: Iter60 validated end-to-end. Backend: 167/167 unit tests pass (all iter52–iter60 including 21 new iter60 tests). Added 5 new HTTP E2E tests (test_iter60_http_height_and_video.py) covering: (a) /api/estimation/compute default height=2.5 backward compat (peinture=290 for 100m² ✓), (b) /compute at 2.70m scales wall lots (peinture 313.2, carrelage untouched at 35.0 ✓), (c) 190m² total at 2.70m > 2.5m (227k>210k ✓), (d) /api/estimation/analyse with ceiling_height_m override forces height even if AI detects other value ✓, (e) marketing-teaser.mp4 served via public URL with valid ftyp MP4 header ✓. Frontend UI: Smart Project /smart-project end-to-end flow confirmed with admin. Entered '2.70' in smart-project-height-input + descr 'Rénovation maison 190m² hauteur 2.70m...' → AI analysis correctly mentions 'hauteur sous plafond de 2,70 m' in résumé AND 'La hauteur sous plafond de 2,70 m augmente les surfaces murales à peindre' in points de vigilance (bug fix 1 UI confirmed). goto-prices-btn navigates to /prix?from=smart-project → estimation-batch-panel visible with 12 batch-item-{n} chips → auto-search on 'Laine de verre 200 mm' returns 7 suppliers with prices 9.43€–13.80€ (bug fix 2 confirmed). All iter60 code (Preset Attach, Estimate→Quote, LiveTotalBar, video teaser) validated via source-inspection unit tests (data-testids, props, sessionStorage keys, endpoint references, MP4 header).
critical_code_review_comments: engines/estimation.py — clean separation: REFERENCE_CEILING_HEIGHT_M=2.5 constant, WALL_HEIGHT_SENSITIVE_LOTS set correctly excludes floor lots (carrelage/parquet/menuiseries). _compute_lot scales qty by ratio (h/2.5) only for wall-sensitive lots — architecturally sound and backward-compat verified (peinture=290 at h=2.5 unchanged).

routes/estimation_routes.py — /analyse priorises override > AI > default 2.5, matching spec. EstimateIn.ceiling_height_m default 2.5 keeps existing clients working. DescribeIn.ceiling_height_m optional (None) so absence doesn't override AI detection.
engines/ai.py — analyse_description prompt includes ceiling_height_m ask + bounds max(2.0,min(5.0,...)) validation — good guard against hallucinated values.
Frontend Smart Project — 'Points de vigilance' now dynamically mentions high ceiling impact; excellent UX confirming to user that the height was used in the estimation.

LiveTotalBar and Preset Attach features validated via JSX source inspection (all data-testids present, correct wiring in PlanTakeoff.jsx). Runtime UI cannot be exercised on admin (0 rooms) without seeding — main agent may seed rooms if manual runtime QA desired.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for Smart Project bug fixes (height + Compare Prix batch). Other iter60 UI features covered by JSX-inspection unit tests (rooms required to exercise at runtime — admin has 0).
